estimator.d: per area, mean over its groups of the absolute ON minus OFF difference of the 10 ms-binned group rate series (L1 over groups); the retained resolution, not a choice
estimator.null: the held-out g=0 replicate pair (g000_on_s1 vs g000_off_s1); the same-seed matched design makes g=0 downstream trajectories bit-identical, so any positive divergence there is signal
estimator.onset: first 10 ms bin where d exceeds the threshold for 5 consecutive bins (50 ms sustained, not a single-bin spike)
estimator.series: series_rate_hz per group from each cell's sealed npz (133 groups, 1300 bins of 10 ms)
estimator.threshold: the maximum downstream per-bin divergence of the held-out g=0 replicate pair plus a 1e-12 float-noise floor
